comments.title: Installing Interior Ladder

lines.text_raw: Cut two 4x4's to 87" in length.
lines.text_rendered: Cut two 4x4's to 87" in length.

lines.text_raw: Mark the first side with the square, then use that line to transfer the mark to the other sides.
lines.text_rendered: Mark the first side with the square, then use that line to transfer the mark to the other sides.

lines.text_raw: Mark 1/2" from the end of each 4x4.
lines.text_rendered: Mark 1/2" from the end of each 4x4.

lines.text_raw: Transfer the line to two of the other sides in a similar manner to step 1.
lines.text_rendered: Transfer the line to two of the other sides in a similar manner to step 1.

lines.text_raw: Set your circular saw blade to a 45 degree angle as seen in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: Set your circular saw blade to a 45 degree angle as seen in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: Bevel 3 of the sides by using the angled blade to cut along the line. The result will look like photo 3.
lines.text_rendered: Bevel 3 of the sides by using the angled blade to cut along the line. The result will look like photo 3.

lines.text_raw: The fourth side does not get beveled because it lays flush against the wall.
lines.text_rendered: The fourth side does not get beveled because it lays flush against the wall.

lines.text_raw: You will add 6 steps to the ladder.
lines.text_rendered: You will add 6 steps to the ladder.

lines.text_raw: The bottom of each step falls on a multiple of 11".
lines.text_rendered: The bottom of each step falls on a multiple of 11".

lines.text_raw: You will measure and make lines at the following measurements: 11" and 12.5", 22" and 23.5", 33" and 34.5", 44" and 45.5", 55" and 56.5", and 66" and 67.5".
lines.text_rendered: You will measure and make lines at the following measurements: 11" and 12.5", 22" and 23.5", 33" and 34.5", 44" and 45.5", 55" and 56.5", and 66" and 67.5".

lines.text_raw: Use the circular saw to cut along each line and then make numerous cuts in between each pair of lines as seen in photo 1.
lines.text_rendered: Use the circular saw to cut along each line and then make numerous cuts in between each pair of lines as seen in photo 1.

lines.text_raw: Use a chisel to clean out these notches as seen in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: Use a chisel to clean out these notches as seen in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: Using an 8' long 2x6, cut 6 pieces that are 16" long each.
lines.text_rendered: Using an 8' long 2x6, cut 6 pieces that are 16" long each.

lines.text_raw: Mark a radius on two corners on the same long side of the step.
lines.text_rendered: Mark a radius on two corners on the same long side of the step.

lines.text_raw: These rounded corners will keep people from getting gouged or snagged on the step edges.
lines.text_rendered: These rounded corners will keep people from getting gouged or snagged on the step edges.

lines.text_raw: Use a jigsaw to cut the rounded corners, as seen in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: Use a jigsaw to cut the rounded corners, as seen in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: Use a sander to sand the rounded corners smooth.
lines.text_rendered: Use a sander to sand the rounded corners smooth.

lines.text_raw: Slide one step into the top and one step into the bottom of the side supports.
lines.text_rendered: Slide one step into the top and one step into the bottom of the side supports.

lines.text_raw: Use a block to tap everything together snugly if the pieces are fitting tightly.
lines.text_rendered: Use a block to tap everything together snugly if the pieces are fitting tightly.

lines.text_raw: Make sure that the assembly is square using your speed square, as shown in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: Make sure that the assembly is square using your speed square, as shown in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: Toe-screw from the underside each step.
lines.text_rendered: Toe-screw from the underside each step.

lines.text_raw: After you have done the top and the bottom step, repeat the process on the intermediate steps.
lines.text_rendered: After you have done the top and the bottom step, repeat the process on the intermediate steps.

lines.text_raw: Assemble the handrail for each side. Each bracket is made of a 3/4" x 1/2" elbow, a 3/4" nipple, and a 3/4" flange ring.
lines.text_rendered: Assemble the handrail for each side. Each bracket is made of a 3/4" x 1/2" elbow, a 3/4" nipple, and a 3/4" flange ring.

lines.text_raw: Make 4 of these as seen in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: Make 4 of these as seen in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: Add the end brackets to the two pieces of 3' long 1/2" pipe. The finished rails look like photo 3.
lines.text_rendered: Add the end brackets to the two pieces of 3' long 1/2" pipe. The finished rails look like photo 3.

lines.text_raw: Paint the handrails with a metal-appropriate paint.
lines.text_rendered: Paint the handrails with a metal-appropriate paint.

lines.text_raw: At the same time, paint 4 small L-brackets with the same color, like in photo 2.
lines.text_rendered: At the same time, paint 4 small L-brackets with the same color, like in photo 2.

lines.text_raw: The L-brackets will be used to attach the ladder to the wall in the MicroHouse.
lines.text_rendered: The L-brackets will be used to attach the ladder to the wall in the MicroHouse.

lines.text_raw: The top of the ladder is the side with extra space.
lines.text_rendered: The top of the ladder is the side with extra space.

lines.text_raw: Lay out one of the handrails so that the flange comes to rest just below the bevel. The other end with land right next to step.
lines.text_rendered: Lay out one of the handrails so that the flange comes to rest just below the bevel. The other end with land right next to step.

lines.text_raw: Make sure that the overlap of the flange is on the outside. This will keep people's clothes from catching on it as the go up and down.
lines.text_rendered: Make sure that the overlap of the flange is on the outside. This will keep people's clothes from catching on it as the go up and down.

lines.text_raw: Screw the flanges as seen in photo 3 and repeat for the other side.
lines.text_rendered: Screw the flanges as seen in photo 3 and repeat for the other side.

lines.text_raw: Mount the ladder to the MicroHouse wall using the 4 L-brackets, two on the top and two on the bottom.
lines.text_rendered: Mount the ladder to the MicroHouse wall using the 4 L-brackets, two on the top and two on the bottom.
